infobox.usage: - Unlocks the cash registers of the IDEA store on Interchange - Unlocks the cash registers of the NecrusPharm pharmacy on Interchange

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: IDEA cash register key (IDEA reg.) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the IDEA store outlet cash registers at the ULTRA shopping mall.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - 1 needs to be obtained for the quest Supervisor

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Interchange
sections.text: - On the seat of a white bus located outside of the IDEA store

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text:
- Cash registers in the front of the Idea store on Interchange.

- Cash registers in the NecrusPharm pharmacy on Interchange.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- IDEA store:
  - 20x Cash register TAR2-2
- NecrusPharm pharmacy:
  - 2x Cash register TAR2-2
